name: camphor (synthetic)
uses: Do not use • on children • on irritated skin • in or near eyes or mucous membranes • on wounds or damaged skin • if prone to allergic reaction from any of the ingredient • on large areas of the body. • if you are taking any other medication or drinking alcohol • if safety seal is torn, broken or missing.
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor • if condition worsens or cleans up and occurs again • if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or irritation or severe burning occurs.
